purpose: Search-led, evidence-curious topic guidance for SymptomCalm. Use trends as question signals, never as medical claims.
source_notes: Soliant Health's 2026 search analysis highlights sleep, bloating, stress, fatigue, back pain, allergies and congestion as recurring consumer questions.
A Journal of Allergy and Clinical Immunology analysis reports recurring allergy-search peaks in spring and fall, with related sleep and mental-health questions.
2026 wellness coverage repeatedly emphasizes sleep optimization, circadian rhythm, screen-related restlessness, stress resilience, gut health and metabolic health.

priority_lanes.TCM_angle: Use TCM as a pattern-language lens for congestion, fatigue and sleep; do not imply treatment or prevention.
Explain rhythm, recovery and pattern observation with practical low-risk habits and medical safety boundaries.

priority_lanes.lane: stress, digital overload and nervous-system language
priority_lanes.TCM_angle: Translate Qi-stagnation as a traditional metaphor, not a diagnosis; include evidence limits and clinician red flags.
Focus on observation experiments, meal context and when persistent symptoms need medical assessment.
Connect everyday rhythm and environmental context to TCM theory without claiming a cure.

selection_rules: Prefer a real user question with one primary search intent and a specific modifier.
Use one trend keyword plus one stable evergreen keyword; avoid keyword stuffing.
Do not chase unrelated viral topics, drugs, supplements, weight-loss promises, or disease-treatment claims.
Before publishing, check existing titles and bodies for semantic overlap; reject near-duplicates.
Every article must include evidence limits, practical takeaways, red flags, disclaimer and a comment question.
